notes.title: Official Patch Announcement: Update 1.1.0 🎉
notes.content:
Greetings, Explorers!

We're thrilled to bring you Update 1.1.0, packed with important fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

Patch Highlights

🛠️ Cutscene Achievement Fix

The achievement "First Steps" is now properly triggered during cutscenes. No more issues with unlocking your well-deserved rewards!

🛠️ Level 2 Hole Fix

A pesky bug on Level 2 caused players to fall through the map. This issue has been resolved, so no more unexpected trips into the void! 🚫🌌

🛠️ Trigger Improvements for Pop-Up Information

Information pop-ups (like quest messages or tutorial text) will now only display once. This fix eliminates repeated pop-ups, ensuring a smoother and less disruptive experience during combat or exploration.
We’re committed to delivering a polished and enjoyable experience, and we couldn’t do it without your feedback.

If you encounter any other issues or have suggestions, feel free to reach out. Happy gaming, and we’ll see you in the next update!

Stay safe,
The Pens Den

notes.title: Patch June 4th
notes.content:
I finished the training level, worked out all the bugs and fixed the load button. To access it is under the levels button on the main menu. Still working out the achievements and hope the next patch will include that. I am also looking at adding a fun scene more info to come. 
Since I have a solid training level placed this will make me transition from early access to full release. I will be making these changes as soon as the sale ends.
